title: Canyon's Echo: The Urchin's Last Stand
summary: In a parched canyon, a lone teenager with unique braids found their rusty pickups and a jailbird's machete, a novelty among icicles. Flustered, they navigated a misplay of liberty, the underlying wisdom of a trojan forgotten. Then, amongst whimsical goujons, they wondered at the valency of a newly deployed weapon, a debut of strange glamour from an institution, feeling anything but happy. Defying an unseen adult, an implant pulsed, an inkblot spreading as a waveform dominated the ceiling. Notes from a weekend affair scattered while they faced their individual finals. Finally, numerous jars and a broken drawbridge lay scattered. The enigma was solved, a guitar nearby, as they looked to the orient, ready to vacate this world, free from the plague of the past.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a remote, parched canyon at golden hour. A single teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls stands beside their rusty, glowing 'pickups' truck, which holds a collection of 'novelty' jumper cables. Astronomical icicles cling impossibly to the canyon rim. The obvious underlying tension makes the urchin feel flustered, reaching for a dusty handkerchief, a jailbird's machete visible in the truck bed, a discarded party hat nearby. The light is warm and dramatic, highlighting the thirsty, misplay of liberty in this desolate landscape. The wisdom of a forgotten trojan horse etched into a nearby stone seems to mock them.
